name: Gemini CLI
note: Gemini CLI keeps no durable session record: ~/.gemini holds settings, a project list and a .project_root marker per directory, and nothing that describes a conversation. There is no transcript to read, so there are no tokens, no cost and no context figure — and a row that showed zeros would be claiming knowledge this harness does not have. It contributes presence only: the running process, the directory it is working in, and an explicit note that the rest is unknown. The process rule matches the executable name exactly: a path fragment of /bin/gemini also matches /bin/geminid, which the negative probe caught — the second time that check has found an over-broad matcher of mine. Quota comes from Cloud Code's retrieveUserQuota, which is POST-only and reports headroom as a fraction of one per model and token type — 0.87 meaning 87% left, not 0.87% used. The access token is the one the gemini CLI writes to ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json; nothing here refreshes it, so an expired token reports as needing sign-in rather than being silently renewed.
